2026 General Election News: Absentee Voting open October 14 through November 2 

A request for a mailed ballot must be received in the Auditor's Office by 5pm Monday, Oct. 19. In person absentee voting continues through November 2, including SATURDAY, Oct. 31 from 9am to 5pm. 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 

Job Posting - Laborer I 

Applications are available at the Engineer’s Office or on the County website. Applications will be accepted at the Engineer’s Office in Leon until Thursday October 29th, 2026 at 3:00 p.m.
